decisions.reason: The existing same-message MODIFY already captures that internal links must be added before publication, so no additional or corrected Event is needed.
The existing same-message INTRODUCE already establishes images as a prerequisite to publication, so another MODIFY would duplicate the source decision.
Requiring images and internal links before publication does not alter the selected blog keywords or keyword replacement rule.
The publication prerequisite does not change the workflow for providing or selecting blog topics.
The source decision concerns blog publication prerequisites and does not change campaign keyword selection or page mapping.
The webpage text replacement remains valid unchanged and is independent of the blog publication condition.
Adding images to blog articles before publication does not entail any decision about ALT attributes for those images or existing website images.
The blog publication condition does not affect the requirement to include search-volume data in the keyword research sheet.
